dimensions_mm: Recess-mounted: 145 x 38 x 9; flush-mounted: 160 x 52 x 48
features: Modular AXIS F-Series sensor unit — requires a separate AXIS F34 Main Unit or AXIS F44 Dual Audio Input Main Unit; power, storage, codecs and streaming are provided by the main unit
Two synchronized lenses/image sensors (100 mm apart) for stereoscopic imaging
Precision people counting, queue management and heat mapping with Axis partner analytics software
Recessed drop-ceiling or surface mount (adapter included)
release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (ds_f8804_stereo_t10085644_en_1701.pdf). Sensor unit only: power, storage, codecs, protocols and RTSP come from the paired AXIS F-series main unit, so no configs are recorded.
